questions.question: Who took oath as the Chief Justice of Patna High Court in September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice Pavankumar Bhimappa Bajanthri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Justice Pavankumar Bhimappa Bajanthri took oath as the Chief Justice of Patna High Court at Raj Bhavan, Patna.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The oath was administered by Bihar Governor Arif Mohammad Khan in the presence of Bihar CM Nitish Kumar, Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary, and other dignitaries.**
 
• **Justice Bajanthri has vast judicial experience and has previously served in other High Courts, contributing to judicial reforms and key constitutional matters.**
 
• **His appointment is a part of ongoing judicial reshuffles by the Supreme Court Collegium and the Government of India to strengthen leadership in High Courts.**
 
• **As Chief Justice, he will oversee case management, judicial reforms, and strengthening the Patna High Court, which is one of India's oldest High Courts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Patna High Court Overview**__

 __
 
• The Patna High Court was established and formally opened on February 3, 1916, by the then Viceroy of India, Sir Charles Hardinge, with work commencing on March 1, 1916, though its foundation stone was laid in 1913. It began functioning under the Government of India Act 1915, becoming a significant judicial body for the region. 
 
• Inaugurated by: Lord Hardinge, the Governor-General and Viceroy of India
 
• Jurisdiction: Entire state of Bihar
 
• Significance: Known for landmark rulings in constitutional, criminal, and socio-economic matters
 
 
 
• **Background on the Appointment**__
 
 
• Justice Bajanthri's appointment is crucial for addressing pending cases and improving judicial infrastructure in Bihar.
 
• This is part of a wider judicial reform process following the Supreme Court Collegium’s recommendations.

questions.question: Who became the 13th Director of the Botanical Survey of India in September 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Kanad Das.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dr. Kanad Das took charge as the 13th Director of the Botanical Survey of India (BSI) on September 25, 2025, becoming the first mycologist to head the institute.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Kanad Das is an internationally recognized fungal taxonomist with over 165 new species of wild mushrooms and two new genera discovered under his name.**
 
• **He has authored eight books, published 170 research papers, and held key positions at Acharya Jagadish Chandra Bose Indian Botanic Garden and Central National Herbarium.**
 
• **Dr. Das began his career at BSI’s Dehradun center and brings over 25 years of expertise in botanical sciences.**
 
• **His vision includes digitising the national herbarium database, finalising a checklist of India’s lower plant groups, and expanding research on fungal biodiversity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Botanical Survey of India (BSI)__

 __
 
• Established in 1890, headquartered in Kolkata, under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), with 11 regional centres and 4 supporting units.
 
 
 
• Mission of BSI__
 __
 
• Explore, document, and conserve India’s floral wealth, curating specimens and conducting field research across diverse ecological zones.
 
 
 
• Specialization__
 __
 
• Dr. Kanad Das specializes in mycology (fungi taxonomy), marking a first in BSI leadership to recognize fungal biodiversity.
 
 
 
• Vision and Goals__
 
 
• His goals include digitising herbarium specimens, creating a comprehensive checklist of lower plant groups, and advancing research on fungi and other lower plants.

questions.question: Who was elected as the new chair of the Species Survival Commission (SSC) by the IUCN?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vivek Menon.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Vivek Menon, founder of the Wildlife Trust of India (WTI), has been elected as the new chair of the IUCN Species Survival Commission (SSC).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• He is the first Asian to hold this prestigious position.
 
• **The Species Survival Commission (SSC) is a science-based network of over 10,500 volunteer experts worldwide.**
 
• **It is one of the six expert commissions under IUCN that advises on biodiversity and species conservation matters.**
 
• **The SSC plays a key role in compiling the IUCN’s Red List of Threatened Species.**
 
• **The IUCN, founded in 1948, is the world’s largest environmental network with over 1,400 member organizations and 17,000 experts.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• IUCN__

 __
 
• Founded in 1948, IUCN is a global environmental organization
 
• It works on biodiversity conservation and sustainable use of natural resources
 
 
 
• Red List of Threatened Species__
 
 
• A globally recognized inventory that evaluates the extinction risk of species
 
• It helps in conservation planning and prioritization of species protection efforts

questions.question: Which candidate did CP Radhakrishnan defeat in the election for the 15th Vice President of India?

 __

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the CEO of Bank of America NA (BANA) in India for a three-year term? (Dec 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Sahu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has approved the appointment of Vikram Sahu as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Bank of America NA (BANA) in India for a three-year term.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Sahu will continue his role as India Country Executive while leading BANA’s local governance and client strategy.**
 
• **Sahu will also ensure regulatory alignment for the bank's operations in India.**
 
• **He succeeds Kaku Nakhate, who has been promoted to the position of Chair of Bank of America India.**
 
• **This leadership change is part of Bank of America’s strategic focus on strengthening its presence in the Indian banking market.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Vikram Sahu**__

 __
 
• Appointed as CEO of Bank of America NA (BANA) in India for a three-year term.
 
• Also serves as the India Country Executive for Bank of America.
 
• Brings leadership experience and strategic insights into local banking governance.
 
 
 
• **About Kaku Nakhate**__
 __
 
• Former CEO of Bank of America NA (BANA) in India.
 
• Promoted to Chair of Bank of America India, reflecting the bank’s leadership restructuring.
 
 
 
• **Bank of America’s Focus in India**__
 
 
• Strengthening its operations and presence in the Indian banking sector.
 
• Aligning local strategies with global governance and client management standards.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Secretary of Delhi, effective 1 October 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajeev Verma.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rajeev Verma, an IAS officer of the 1992 batch, has been appointed as the Chief Secretary of Delhi, effective 1 October 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajeev Verma, currently the Chief Secretary of Chandigarh, will replace Dharmendra, who is retiring on 30 September 2025.**
 
• Verma has served in various important roles in the Delhi government, including Finance & Revenue Secretary (2018–22).
 
• He holds a BTech in Computer Science from Roorkee and an MTech from IIT, with vast experience in urban governance and administration.
 
• The key challenges he faces include urban infrastructure management, inter-agency coordination, and the Yamuna river cleanup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Chief Secretary of Delhi__

 __
 
• Top bureaucratic position in the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi.
 
• Coordinates between the Delhi government, central ministries, and agencies.
 
 
 
• Yamuna River Cleanup__
 __
 
• One of the key challenges for Delhi's governance.
 
• A priority task under Rajeev Verma's leadership.
 
 
 
• Urban Infrastructure in Delhi__
 __
 
• Managing transport, water, air quality, waste, and housing in a megacity.
 
• A critical test for administrative capabilities in Delhi.
 
 
 
• AGMUT Cadre__
 
 
• The Arunachal Pradesh‑Goa‑Mizoram & Union Territories (AGMUT) cadre serves various states and Union Territories in India.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as Punjab National Bank’s first-ever female brand ambassador?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmanpreet Kaur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Punjab National Bank (PNB) has appointed Harmanpreet Kaur, captain of the Indian women’s cricket team, as its first-ever female brand ambassador.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur was introduced as PNB’s first female brand ambassador during an event titled “Banking On Champions” in New Delhi.**
 
• **The appointment reflects PNB’s commitment to women empowerment and brand modernisation.**
 
• **Kaur unveiled four major PNB offerings including the RuPay Metal Credit Card Luxura and the upgraded PNB One 2.0 platform.**
 
• **She also announced initiatives like Digi Surya Ghar (solar solutions) and PNB's onboarding on IIBX for online gold bullion trading.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Event Highlights**__

 __
 
• Held at PNB corporate office, New Delhi.
 
• Harmanpreet received a personalised PNB jersey at the launch ceremony.
 
 
 
• **New PNB Offerings Unveiled**__
 __
 
• **PNB RuPay Metal Credit Card Luxura:** Bank’s first metal card for elite customers.
 
• **PNB One 2.0:** Enhanced digital banking interface.
 
• **Digi Surya Ghar:** Service promoting solar-based energy adoption.
 
• **PNB onboarding on IIBX:** Enables customers to trade gold bullion online.
 
 
 
• **Significance for PNB**__
 __
 
• Strengthens brand visibility with a globally recognised sportsperson.
 
• Aligns with PNB’s efforts to appeal to the youth and women customers.
 
 
 
• **About Harmanpreet Kaur**__
 
 
• Captain of the Indian women’s cricket team.
 
• Known for her leadership, power-hitting, and international achievements.

questions.question: Who has been named the First Indian CEO of Procter & Gamble (P&G)?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Shailesh Jejurikar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India-born Shailesh Jejurikar to be next CEO of FMCG giant Procter & Gamble.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Shailesh Jejurikar** has been appointed as the next **Global President and CEO** of **Procter & Gamble (P&G)**.

 
 
• 
 
He will assume office on **January 1, 2026**.

 
 
• 
 
Jejurikar is a **36-year veteran** at P&G and currently serves as the **Chief Operating Officer (COO)**.

This marks the **first time an Indian** will lead **P&G** in its **187-year history**.

 
 
• 
 
The appointment is a **milestone for Indian leadership** in global corporate roles.

 
 
• 
 
It comes at a time of **changing global consumer dynamics**.

questions.question: Who was elected as the President-elect of Chile in the recent election that marked a major conservative shift in the country’s politics? (Dec 2025)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**José Antonio Kast**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Ultra-conservative leader José Antonio Kast was elected President-elect of Chile, marking a significant political shift from the outgoing left-leaning administration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **José Antonio Kast defeated leftist candidate Jeannette Jara** in the presidential election.
 
• **The result marks a departure from the government led by President Gabriel Boric**, indicating voter preference for conservative leadership.
 
• **The election reflects a realignment in Chile’s political landscape** toward ultra-conservative ideology.
 
• **Chile follows a presidential system of government**, where executive power rests with the directly elected president.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Capital of Chile:** Santiago.
 
• **Region:** South America.
 
• **Outgoing President:** Gabriel Boric.
 
• **Form of Government:** Presidential system, with separation of executive and legislative powers.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new chairman of HSBC, succeeding Mark Tucker?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brendan Nelson**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Brendan Nelson has been appointed as HSBC’s new chairman, succeeding Mark Tucker, who served as the first external chair of the bank.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nelson transitioned from interim chairman to the full-time position on December 3, 2025, after joining HSBC’s board in September 2023.**
 
• **He brings expertise in financial auditing, governance, and risk management, having previously held senior roles at KPMG.**
 
• **Nelson will oversee HSBC’s Group Audit Committee until February 2026, after which a new chair will be appointed.**
 
• **He will guide HSBC’s Asia-first strategy, focusing on strengthening the bank’s presence in Asia and scaling back operations in Europe and the US.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mark Tucker’s Tenure**__

 __
 
• Tucker stepped down after an eight-year tenure, which included leading HSBC through the COVID-19 pandemic and managing shareholder pressures.
 
• He also navigated challenges like US-China trade tensions and the decision on HSBC’s Asian operations.
 
 
 
• **Brendan Nelson’s Experience**__
 __
 
• Nelson held senior roles at KPMG, including head of global banking, bringing extensive expertise in governance, risk management, and financial auditing.
 
• He joined HSBC’s board in September 2023 before transitioning to interim chairman in October 2025.
 
 
 
• **HSBC’s Asia-First Strategy**__
 
 
• The strategy focuses on scaling down operations in Europe and the US while expanding HSBC’s presence in Asia.
 
• This move follows CEO Georges Elhedery’s restructuring of HSBC in late 2024.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new Chief Medical Officer (CMO) of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN) in December 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Renuka Iyer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Renuka Iyer, MD, has been appointed as the new Chief Medical Officer (CMO) of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Dr. Iyer currently serves as Professor of Oncology at Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center.**
 
• **She has served on multiple NCCN Guidelines Panels, including Hepatobiliary Cancer and Occult Primary Cancer.**
 
• **Her role as CMO includes leadership of the NCCN Guidelines program, oversight of CE programs, and editorial involvement with JNCCN.**
 
• **Her first day as CMO will be February 26, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN)**__

 __
 
• A not-for-profit alliance of leading cancer centers founded 30 years ago.
 
• Publishes evidence-based NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology.
 
• Guidelines cover nearly all cancer types and are updated at least once each year.
 
• NCCN also manages global initiatives, continuing education, and patient-focused guidelines.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Renuka Iyer – Background**__
 __
 
• Professor of Medicine at Jacobs School of Medicine, University at Buffalo.
 
• Section Chief of Gastrointestinal Oncology at Roswell Park.
 
• Fellowship-trained in medical oncology at Roswell Park.
 
• Noted for research on rare cancers, immunotherapy, biomarkers, and quality-of-life improvements.
 
 
 
• **NCCN Guidelines Program**__
 
 
• Consists of 90 guidelines covering treatment, prevention, and supportive care.
 
• Features the NCCN Guidelines Navigator™, an interactive access platform.
 
• Supported by the Library of NCCN Compendia for point-of-care decision tools.

questions.question: Who has become the first woman Attorney General of Nepal?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sabita Bhandari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Sabita Bhandari Becomes First Woman Attorney General of Nepal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• 
 
**Sabita Bhandari**, Senior Advocate, has been appointed as the **new Attorney General** of Nepal.

 
 
• 
 
She is the **first woman** to hold the position in the Himalayan nation.

 
 
• 
 
Appointment made by **President Ramchandra Paudel** on the recommendation of **PM Sushila Karki** under **Article 157(2) of the Constitution**.

 
 
• 
 
She succeeds **Ramesh Badal**, who resigned from the post effective **September 9, 2025**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
**Nepal**: Capital – **Kathmandu**, Currency – **Nepalese Rupee (NPR)**, Official language – **Nepali**.

 
 
• 
 
**Attorney General of Nepal**: The **chief legal advisor** to the Government, appointed under Article 157 of the Constitution of Nepal (2015).

 
 
• 
 
**Ramchandra Paudel**: Current **President of Nepal** since March 2023.

 
 
• 
 
**Sushila Karki**: Nepal’s **first female interim Prime Minister**, formerly the country’s first female Chief Justice.
